verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes is compute infrastructure: isolated containers that execute code for agents. It is not itself an agent or tool-consuming client, so plugging MCP servers into it so that "it" can use their tools is the wrong axis for this kind of product. The one MCP-related item (modal-comm-2) describes a third-party agent runtime controlling Modal Sandboxes over gRPC. That is an external client using Modal, not Modal consuming MCP tools, so it does not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
